bytedance-ai-image-gen v2.4.2

- No code or functionality changes.  
- Internal metadata updated only.  
- No impact on user experience or features.

- Updated skill description and documentation for clearer usage instructions and parameter inference rules.
- Added detailed step-by-step configuration guide, including required environment variables and console setup steps.
- Emphasized strict operational guidelines: users must not be prompted for confirmation before execution, and all triggers must result in immediate action.
- Clarified command formats for text-to-image, image-to-image, multi-image fusion, and usage synchronization.
- Outlined daily model usage limits and automatic fallback behaviors.
- Provided concise rules and size inference logic for streamlined skill activation and compliance.

- Initial release of ByteDance AI Image Gen skill, supporting free image generation and editing using Doubao/ByteDance Seedream models.
- Enables text-to-image, image-to-image, batch image creation, multi-image blending, and advanced image editing features.
- Smart model routing with automatic fallback: Seedream-4.5 → 5.0-Lite → 4.0, each model limited to 18 uses per day.
- CLI-based usage with auto parameter inference; image resolution and aspect ratio are detected or adapted automatically.
- Simple setup with required API keys and model IDs; usage does not require user confirmation.
- Fully documented commands, trigger patterns, and error handling.

## bytedance-ai-image-gen 2.3.3 Changelog

- Metadata file updated; version number remains at 2.3.0.
- No user-facing changes or new features in this release.

- Improved documentation with clearer setup instructions, usage commands, and strict behavior guidelines.
- Enhanced parameter inference rules for image generation, editing, and fusion.
- Clarified model selection process and limitations, including daily usage caps and feature support for each model.
- Added detailed instructions for environment variable configuration and optional IAM integration.
- Emphasized immediate command execution upon trigger, with strict rules to avoid unnecessary confirmations.

- Update version from 2.3.0 to 2.3.1 in metadata.
- No other content changes.

- Improved automatic size and aspect ratio inference: “2K” and “4K” now use adaptive (default 16:9) proportions instead of always square.
- Added new “3K” preset (3072²), used with 16:9/9:16 triggers for better widescreen/vertical results.
- Updated handling for specific prompt words: e.g., “宽屏/横版/16:9” triggers 3K+16:9, “竖版/9:16” triggers 3K+9:16, “电影” triggers 4K+21:9.
- Documentation and usage instructions updated to reflect the new dimension rules and selection logic.

ByteDance AI Image Gen v1.0.1

- Initial release of the skill, providing image generation via Doubao/ByteDance Seedream models.
- Supports text-to-image, image-to-image (local path, URL, base64), multi-image blending, and sequential image generation.
- Intelligent scheduling and daily usage limit for each model (Seedream-4.5, 5.0 Lite, 4.0; 18/day each).
- Triggered only by specific keywords and phrases related to image generation or editing.
- Strict rules: never confirm usage or parameters with the user; automatically infer resolution/ratio.
- Includes CLI usage instructions, environment variable setup, and a robust workflow for image creation and management.
